title: The number hiding in a matrix
question: What does one number computed from a square matrix tell you?
hook: Squash a shape flat and a single number drops to zero.
idea: The determinant is the factor by which a transformation scales volume, and a matrix over a field can be inverted exactly when it is nonzero.

beats.prompt: Two arrows from the origin lie along the same line, so the parallelogram they span is squashed flat. What is the determinant of the 2 by 2 matrix with those arrows as columns?

choices.label: A positive number, since the arrows have length
choices.feedback: Length alone does not give area; the flat parallelogram encloses none.

choices.label: A negative number, since they point the same way
choices.feedback: The sign records which way one arrow turns to reach the other, and here there is no turn.

beats.explain: The determinant is the signed area of the parallelogram, and aligned vectors give zero.

beats.prompt: Match each tool to where determinants help it.
pairs: Finding inflexion points of plane curves
beats.explain: Determinants occur throughout mathematics, from equation solving to calculus to algebraic geometry.

beats.prompt: One step in this reasoning is wrong. Which?
steps: Square matrix A has determinant 2 and square matrix B has determinant 0.
The determinant of a product of two square matrices is the product of their determinants.
So AB has determinant 2 plus 0, which is 2.
A nonzero determinant means AB is invertible.
beats.explain: The rule multiplies determinants; it does not add them. The product is 2 times 0, which is zero, so AB is not invertible.

beats.prompt: A 2 by 2 matrix has a positive determinant. You swap its two columns, so the arrows now turn the opposite way. What happens to the determinant?

choices.label: Same size, same sign
choices.feedback: The sign tells which way one arrow rotates to reach the other, and swapping reverses that turn.

choices.label: Half the size, same sign
choices.feedback: The parallelogram is the same, so its area is unchanged.

choices.label: It becomes zero
choices.feedback: Zero would need the arrows to lie on one line, which swapping does not cause.

beats.explain: The area stays the same, but the direction of rotation reverses, so the sign flips.
